sentences.text:
15.06.2024 Mr. Jameel Akhtar Lohani, counsel for the
 petitioner.
Heard.
Admit.
Issue notice to the respondents on payment of PF through ordinary as well as registered mode.
Also heard on I.A. No.01, an application for grant of stay.
The instant petition has been filed against the award passed on 12.11.2022 by the National Lok Adalat/ 2nd Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bilaspur in Claim Case No.1547/2021.

entities.text: National Lok Adalat/ 2nd Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bilaspur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: In the said claim case, the wife and the minor son, suppressing the mother of the deceased (present petitioner herein), filed a claim case.
The present petitioner being mother had also filed a separate Claim Case No.137/2022 before the 1 st MACT, Raigarh on 12.08.2022 by making proper party to widow and minor child.
The widow had entered into a compromise before the National Lok Adalat and an award has been passed.
Thereafter, the mother had withdrawn her case on 11.10.2023.
In view of such backdrop, learned counsel for the petitioner prays to allow I.A. No.01/2024 and the further disbursement of the amount to meet the ends of justice.

After filing an application for compensation arising out of the accident, a proforma has been set in M.P.M.V.R.-75 (COMP-A)
under the C.G Motor Vehicles Rules, 1994, in which Rule 220 clearly stipulates that every application must be satisfied the contents of such proforma.
In the proforma, the claimant has a duty to declare on oath that no other claim in respect of said accident has been filed or pending before any other forum.
The claim petition has been preferred at Raigarh only because the mother is residing separately with the daughter-in-law on account of differences.
Without enquiring the said fact, learned counsel for the claimant has changed the contents of the proforma and mentioned that the claimant has not preferred any other claim for such accident.
While drafting the claim petition, the contents of proforma would not be changed and the necessary disclosure must be made.

Further the claim petition which was filed before the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bilaspur, a duty has been cast on the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal to examine the petitioner and Rule 223 of the Rules, 1994 read thus:-

Padmavati Sahu vs Ravi Kumar Chouhan on 15 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/6129319/
1 "223. Examination of applicant.-On receipt of an application under Rule 220 the Claims Tribunal may examine the applicant on oath and the substance of such examination shall be reduced to writing and shall be signed by the Claims Tribunal."

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In the aforesaid preliminary examination, it is expected from the Claims Tribunal to ascertain the dependents of the deceased especially about widow, children, mother and father of the deceased and on such preliminary enquiry, if the Claims Tribunal finds that some of the dependents have not been arrayed as a party in the petition, in order to avoid further complications, it shall make a suitable order for addition of the party.
It is further expected that the Nodal Officer of the Insurance Company, after accident, on the basis of bare report of the investigator, shall apprise the Claims Tribunal about the factual position and also to make an offer under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.
In view of above, this Court deems it appropriate to grant stay to the extent of 20% of the award and further disbursement of the awarded amount in the Motor Accident Claims No.1547/2021.
Let a copy of this order be sent to the concerned Claims Tribunal for necessary compliance forthwith and in turn the same shall be informed to the concerned Bank.

Registrar General is also directed to issue an appropriate circular to all the Claims Tribunal of the State for strict adherence of the examination of the applicant under Rule 223 of the C.G Motor Vehicles Rules, 1994.
List this matter for final hearing immediately after service is complete.

Sd/-
(Deepak Kumar Tiwari) Judge Priyanka Padmavati Sahu vs Ravi Kumar Chouhan on 15 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/6129319/
